subject: Inter beat Como 2-0 to trail Lazio by one point
title: Inter beat Como, Lazio one point ahead

lines.vo: Fifty-seven percent possession, one shot on target, and no points.
Como had the ball. Inter had the goals. Inter won two-nil at San Siro.
Pio Esposito scored in the twelfth minute. Marcus Thuram doubled it in the nineteenth.
Possession is not a scoreboard. Como had one shot on target.
lines.footage: Inter Como Serie A Thuram goal

lines.vo: Meanwhile, Lazio's six-game winning run ended in a one-one draw at Napoli.
Six wins in a row for Lazio, two goals for Inter, one point between them. Suddenly the table is interesting.
